title: The Nature of Black Magic and Its Antidote
body:
(Mawlana Shaykh stands)
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, `Azeez Allah!
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Rabbun Allah!
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Subhaan Allah!
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Sultaan Allah!
Wa la qad hamd yaa Rabb wa shukr. mila 's-samawaatil mila 'l-ard wa mila maa shi'ta min shayin ba`ad. O
our Lord! Give Your most high praisings than what You are granting to anyone in Creation, to whom You
created all Creation for his honor, Sayyidina Muhammad (s)! Zidhu yaa Rabbee `izzan wa sharafan nooran
wa suroora, wa ridwaanan wa sultaanan wa haybatan wa ghafaaran. (Mawlana Shaykh sits) Wa `ala sai'ira 'lanbiya wa 'l-awliya wa man tabi`ahum bi ihsaan il-yawmi 'd-deen wa ila 'l-abad.
As-salaamu `alaykum, yaa Saahib az-Zamaan. As-salaamu `alaykum, yaa Qutb al-Mutasarrif, who is making
everything under his heavenly authority; that is Qutb al-Mutasarrif. A person can't do something on this
planet without an authority from the Heavens. As-salaamu `alayk, yaa Qutb al-Mutasarrif! We are humbly
asking support, as mush as we can carry. Your support can carry this world! We are asking only a small spot
from your heavenly authority, a small drop from one ocean. Hafizhna, please look after weak servants of the

Lord of Heavens!
We are all weak servants, but our egos are using a mirror that if you look in it you may see your being as onehundred or one-thousand times bigger, or in such a way. Shaytan has a magic mirror, bringing in front of
anyone and showing, "Look," then that one sees, "I am such an important one, a big one, and no one can
approach me. I am such a big and gigantic one in Creation. Ohhh, ohhh, Mankind, you must respect me with
your full respect because I am such a huge being. Look at me!" People see him as he is seeing himself, like
such a gigantic one. That is magic! SubhaanAllah. Shaytan is the biggest magic maker! No one can be like
Shaytan to show magic to people.
O our Attenders! As -salaamu `alaykum. We are saying, a`oodhu billahi min ash-Shaytani 'r-rajeem from his
magic. (Mawlana Shaykh stands) Bismillahi 'r-Rahmani 'r-Raheem. We are taking our heavenly sword to
destroy Shaytan's magic. Use it, Mankind! (Mawlana Shaykh sits) As-salaamu `alaykum, our attenders! All
people from the east and the west are attending. You must attend; for everything that belongs to the Lord of
Heavens, you must listen and obey or you will be punished and vanish!
O Salafi `ulamas! As-salaamu `alaykum also to those who are giving titles by themselves, to themselves. It is
not coming to you that you are Salaaf as-Saalih or you are followers of Salaaf as-Saalih? Do you have any
evidence? Show us or you are giving that title to yourself. I am saying a "title," which may be true or untrue.
Yes, a title that people are giving is imitated. (...) Marhaban, Salafi `ulamas! Where are you? Allah likes His
servants to be happy, therefore I am joking with you sometimes. Your faces are always very solemn. A smile
for the sake of Allah (is good). (Mawlana Shaykh stands) Is Allah smiling, I am asking you. If Allah is not
smiling, how are we going to smile? Is Allah always angry or showing His anger? Never! Why are you doing
the opposite? (Mawlana Shaykh sits) Shaytan always makes you solemn or angry towards other people,
because you are thinking they are on the wrong way and you are on the true, right way.
Our teacher, the Seal of Prophets (s), taught people everything. Therefore, you must teach people everything
that has been taught by the Seal of Prophets, Sayyidina ‘l-Awwaleen wa ’l-Akhireen! Yes, that title you are
giving to yourself, saying to people, “We are Salafiyoon,” who is making a seal on it? Is it from common
people or from government people? Are they putting a seal? Both of them have no value! They are asking for
a heavenly seal that confirms you are Salafiyoon. You must know that for everyone who is asking a title or a

higher level, he must come and prove he is on that level and then comes a heavenly seal and saying, "This one
Salafi and this one is Salaaf as-Saalih." If not, don’t claim something that is not sealed by a heavenly seal.
What are you saying about magic? Is there magic? You can't say no, because there is magic. Now in our days,
Mankind never fears from anything except magic. And people are running to some for relief, thinking they
are under a magic stress or magic pressure, that magic is never allowing them to reach something they are
asking, or they fear from magic they will be unable to keep the level they are on. Is there magic? What is your
answer? You must say, "Yes, there is magic." Magic means quwwat ash-sharr, power of evil combined in a
small spot of an atom. That magic is making people to be in unrest. Magic is a fitnah, corruption for all of
Mankind.
I am a weak servant. Daily every kind of Mankind is coming to me: Turks, Arabs, Iranians, Russians,
Europeans, Americans, from Arabs, from Egypt. From everywhere people complain, "O Shaykh! There is
black magic on me." What is that? How can it be? A person can't be under a magical effect if it is not coming
from a sharr, point.
Who is controlling evil on Earth? Say! That is knowledge you must know, because Allah (swt) yaqul Haaroot
wa Maaroot, the two angels. In the Holy Qur'an is written about, `ala 'l-malakayni, two angels, one is
"Haaroot", and the other, "Maaroot". (cf. Al-Baqara, 2:102) That means there is magic and people are saying
mostly that it is black magic. They fear that, but they don't fear Allah because they are idiot, ignorant ones!
Then Allah Almighty leads them through those unexpected Evil Oceans and they never taste the sweetness of
life. They have been granted everything, they have everything, but for the sake of black magic, their lives are
going to be tasteless, because they are believing in black magic.
And daily so many people are coming to me, calling me by phone and writing, "O Shaykh! There is black
magic on me. What can I do?" The whole world now is under the darkness of black magic. There is no rest for
Mankind. For what? Allah Almighty is sending those disobedient, disloyal people, giving their punishment
here, because they do not fear their Creator! They are not giving full respect for their Creator, Allah Almighty!
Then Allah Almighty assaults them with black magic, which is a cloud from the east to the west, from the
north to the south. And people are running, “There is a shaykh.” Where? In Saudi Arabia, shaykhs say, "We
do not believe in such a thing.” But some are then punished by black magic! Then they also write to me,

saying,
“O Shaykh! We think that we have been affected by black magic, please tell us what can we do! Show us a way
to save ourselves."
I am saying, "Put one-billion dollars here and I shall tell you!"
"It is too much, O Shaykh! I am asking my master."
Second day, "Are you asking?"
"I am asking."
"Never coming down. Go think on it, then come."
They are going and never coming back. Some of them are going to the graveyard and some of them are in
mental houses.
O People of the 21st century! Be clever ones, that the Lord of Heavens will not send on you an assault of black
magic from ifreets and shaytans to make you in unrest! You may have everything, but from that assault you
will be in unrest.
O People! Come here, I shall speak to them. I may teach you the way that you can be saved from black magic.
I am saying, go to Salafi `ulamas, they know too much! (laughter) Some Salafi `ulamas are asking, “O my
shaykh! What can you do for me? I know I am under heavy pressure of sihar, black magic. What can I do? We
are not working on it, but we heard there is a shaykh on a small island and they are saying he may take away
black magic from people." "Who is that one?” “Everyday swearing on us, go to that one, go.” We are fearing
him also, if we are answering to him, sending to us black magic also."
I am not that one. I am not doing magic, but we have an authority for protecting and saving people from
black magic! All servants that belong to a heavenly center have that authority, and black magic makers fear
them! If they are not fearing, at the end of year they are going to be under the Earth!
O People! If you are asking to save yourselves from black magic, who is its teacher? Say, Salafi `ulamas! Who
is that one? Say his name! Shaytan; it is true. You know that only Shaytan may do black magic. And if anyone
is asking to learn it, he must leave his faith and follow Shaytan, then that person is going to be like Shaytan.
Say, Allah Almighty protects us from Shaytan and shaytanic works and shaytanic actions.

O People! Come to the right way. If you are coming on the right way, if millions of Haaroot wa Maaroot are
attacking on you, they can’t do anything. But you are escaping from your Lord and His Servanthood, and that
is your punishment here, and the punishment on the Last Day is going to be heavy.
O People! Come to this holy month and try to renew your faith! You must try to do everything as the Lord of
Heavens is ordering, or that punishment is always going to be with you, and Shaytan and his followers will
never stop making magic on you, and magic-making people will not get out from humanity. You are showing
yourselves in a mirror a very bad and ugly show. They will see themselves and they will ask to run away, but
they cannot.
O People! Leave black magic and come and follow reality with heavenly ones who may take black magic from
the whole world and from all people, or that is going to be always a punishment for unbelievers and for
disobedient people, so that they won't taste a sweet taste in this life. Come and say, "Tawbah, yaa Rabbee.
Tawbah, yaa Rabbee. Tawbah, astaghfirullah. Tawbah, yaa Rabbee. Tawbah, yaa Rabbee. Tawbah,
astaghfirullah. For the honor of this month, we are leaving Shaytan and coming to Your Way! O our Lord,
keep us on the best way or Your best one's way, the Seal of Prophets, Sayyidina Muhammad (s)!" (Mawlana
Shaykh stands and sits)
O People! Come to Allah, and to His representatives. They are prophets, and all of them are representatives of
the Seal of Prophets (s), who is a guarantee for all prophets, and all prophets’ guarantees are for their nations.
Those who are coming with prophets will be saved. If not, they will not find a safe place or guarantee from
black magic and its dark tunnels. Their lives are going to pass up to the end in black magic tunnels.May Allah
(swt) forgive us!
O People! As-salaamu `alaykum. Tawbah, yaa Rabbee. Tawbah, yaa Rabbee. Tawbah, yaa Rabbee. Tawbah,
astaghfirullah.
Fatihah.
(Mawlana Shaykh speaks to Shaykh Hisham Effendi and Hajjah Naziha on the phone.)
(844) Mashaa-Allah. Shaykh Hisham, ooohhh, up, up, up, a million people. Yes, yes. Alhamdulillah,

subhaanAllah wa shukrulillah.
(Mawlana Shaykh prays two raka'at Salaat ash-Shukr)
